audited_plan.image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of the head and upper neck of a Nile crocodile resting on sandy ground. The image focuses on the textured dorsal scutes, the eye with a vertical pupil, and the interlocking teeth of the closed jaw.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers distinctly towards the nostrils, forming the characteristic V-shape of a crocodile rather than the U-shape of an alligator. The head structure appears anatomically correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple conical teeth are clearly visible protruding from the jawline even while the mouth is closed, demonstrating the interlocking arrangement typical of crocodilians.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is located on the top ridge of the skull (dorsal). A distinct vertical slit pupil is visible. The surrounding eyelid structure suggests the presence of the nictitating membrane mechanism.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Although partially obscured by the angle, the nasal region is at the anterior terminus of the snout, consistent with crocodile anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the neck and head shows heavy armor plating (scutes), implying the elongated armored body described in the taxonomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture displays distinct, raised, rectangular scutes arranged in organized rows along the back of the head and neck.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of olive-green, brown, and grey. The surface is highly textured with cracks and ridges, matching the 'rough' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a dorsal/lateral close-up; the belly (ventral surface) is completely occluded by the ground and the angle of the subject.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No limbs or feet are visible in this tight crop of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is outside the frame.
